starAccomplishments.title: Secure Cloud File Sharing Service with Expiring HMAC Tokens
starAccomplishments.situation: Enterprise systems frequently suffer from unauthorized data exfiltration due to statically shared cloud download links and overly permissive IAM policies.

starAccomplishments.action: Built Python Flask microservice integrating AWS S3, DynamoDB, SES, and Lambda; generated HMAC-SHA256 signed download tokens expiring in 15 minutes.
starAccomplishments.result: Achieved least-privilege IAM compliance, zero unauthorized file access vulnerabilities, and automated S3 lifecycle garbage collection.

starAccomplishments.title: Enterprise STRIDE Threat Modeling Portfolio

starAccomplishments.result: Authored comprehensive mitigation roadmap specifying 802.1X enterprise authentication, WPA3-Enterprise encryption, and micro-segmentation.
